label: Contracts: the loaded-contract classifier (front-loaded/back-loaded, max 5 per roster) now matches desktop Front Office and the Trade War Room exactly — a plain, unsuffixed one- or two-year extension no longer over-counts against the limit just because its frozen prior year differs from the new extension year(s), and the MYAC-loaded and loaded-extension gates refuse to proceed (instead of guessing) if the count can't be verified right now.
